display.description_en: Connect the DataBuddy knowledge base, powered by Tencent Cloud Big Data, to let AI answer with real enterprise data — for more trustworthy Q&A, reports, anomaly attribution, forecasting, and related-signal analysis, plus dashboards that refresh in real time.
display.description_zh: 连接腾讯云大数据 DataBuddy 数据知识库，让 AI 基于企业真实数据作答——问数、报告、异动归因、预测、相关信号分析更可信，并可生成实时更新的仪表盘。
examples_en: Query last month's GMV and its month-over-month change?
Generate an operations data report for each store
Detect whether order transaction counts have any anomalies over the past 90 days
Analyze the attribution dimensions behind the drop in a certain model's order conversion rate
Forecast the next 30 days' trend of game user-acquisition conversion and ROI
Build an order sales operations dashboard based on the order data knowledge base
examples_zh: 统计上个月 GMV 是多少，环比涨跌多少？
帮我生成一份各门店经营数据报告
检测近 90 天交易笔数是否存在异常波动
分析某车型订单转化率下降的归因维度
预测未来 30 天游戏买量转化与 ROI 走势
基于订单数据知识库，搭建一个订单销售运营看板
